note: ZOMBIE GAME MADE BY CLAUDE ("LULLABY") is capture-class: the itch.io HTML5 embed served from https://html-classic.itch.zone/html/19679752/ (entry index.html -> assets/index-DaQlAVPp.js, a Vite-style ES-module build with ~40 lazy chunks and runtime tex/ + audio/ asset banks). §0.4 fork-over-mirror was checked on 2026-10-13 — no public upstream repo exists (the itch page and the game bundle carry no repo link; GitHub search finds nothing for the game or the author slug heromouteut-ai), so the mirror stands. Derived pipeline: capture → pinned prettier 3.9.6 (module API, default options, rendered to fixpoint (format until the output stops changing, max 5 passes) — never the CLI: it respects .gitignore and can silently echo its input) → readable/<served path>.pretty.js per captured JS file (the capture preserves the served URL structure, so the derived layers MIRROR it — nested directories, served chunk filenames kept — PLAN §5; the capture sits at the repo root, so the paths are readable/assets/<chunk>.pretty.js; every pretty provably NOT byte-identical to its capture source) → statement-aligned slices src/assets/<chunk>-NN.js of every APP chunk (top-level declaration boundaries only, ~250-350 line windows; oversized single declarations stay whole) with an exact 2-line provenance header. Every slice parses standalone under `node --input-type=module --check -` and round-trips byte-exact to its recorded readable line range through the recorded semantic rename map (rename-map.json; a slice with no map record round-trips verbatim). Machinery rule — the Vite build machinery at the head of the entry chunk (the __vite__mapDeps chunk table + the modulepreload polyfill IIFE + the preload helper) is wholeFile. Vendor rule — the bundled three.js r185 region inside assets/index-DaQlAVPp.js (constants/revision table through the WebGL renderer and the module namespace object) is wholeFile, content-anchored between the license comment and the app's renderer factory and asserted; the two three.js examples/jsm addon chunks (RoundedBoxGeometry, BufferGeometryUtils) are wholeFile too; vendor identifiers are never renamed. Non-standalone parts are skipped sections, indexed but never sliced: every chunk's final export {…} table (the exported bindings live in the earlier slices; the campaign renames their LOCAL side only — the public names are the capture's own API names and never change; the chunk's fired binding map is recorded per source as renameBindings for the reconstruction gates). Inline <script>/<style> scan: index.html carries one inline <style> content block (its readable twin readable/index-inline-1.pretty.css is recorded in readable/index-inline-map.json with byte range + sha256); its external scripts (the app chunk and itch's chrome script) are not derived. The identifier rename campaign (PLAN §5) is applied as a recorded layer (tools/names.json → tools/apply-names.mjs → rename-map.json → re-applied here on every re-cut); vendor identifiers stay minified. Capture bytes are untouched by everything above; re-cut with `node tools/derive.mjs` after any capture refresh. `node tools/audit.js` is the gate.
